title: Morning rush in London: every bus and tram, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in London, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus and tram inside Greater London on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside Greater London are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Superloop, Night bus and Tram, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 6,311 vehicles at 8:20 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
